data.name: Speechbound - A language RPG
data.short_description: In Speechbound: a Language Learning RPG you'll step in the role of Zero to save the planet! Engage in a captivating narrative, battle formidable foes, tackle exciting language exercises, and discover the beauty of Babyl Moon. Learn a language, save the world!
data.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Simplified Chinese*, Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit or Windows® 10 32-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 10 series, AMD Radeon™ HD 6000 series, AMD Radeon™ 500 series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS Ventura
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel® Core™ i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ 500 series for Intel® CPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
